prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic garden editorial with pearl accessories, yellow plaid fashion, and rabbits handled humanely.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional blonde woman with soft waves, pearl choker and earrings, secure yellow-and-white plaid puff dress with opaque yellow tights and glossy yellow heels; seated upright on a stone bench holding loose decorative pearl leads while a rabbit rests comfortably in her arms.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level 35mm estate garden portrait, manicured hedges, tiger statue, tiered dolphin fountain, golden-hour lawn, yellow, green, white, and warm-gold palette; no garment text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural golden-hour light, warm glow, realistic grass, hair, water, fabric, and rabbit texture.
prompt.technical_specs: RAW photorealism, f/2.8, sharp subject and soft background roll-off, realistic hands and animal anatomy, no logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic garden fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional blonde woman with pearl jewelry, secure yellow-and-white plaid puff dress, opaque yellow tights and glossy yellow heels, seated upright on a stone bench holding loose decorative pearl leads while a comfortable rabbit rests in her arms, manicured estate garden, tiger statue, tiered fountain, golden-hour light, 35mm f/2.8, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sheer stockings, sexualized bent-over pose, animal distress, tight restraint, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
